title.headline: Arsenal v Chelsea
say: Arsenal against Chelsea. Here's how it went!
Arsenal against Chelsea. Here we go!
Arsenal, Chelsea. Here we go!
Arsenal, Chelsea.

beats.headline: Kick-off: Arsenal v Chelsea
beats.line: Hear me: Arsenal and Chelsea are under way. Let the drums speak.
say: We're under way! Arsenal against Chelsea.
We're under way!

beats.headline: OFF THE POST! Cole Palmer so close
beats.line: Cole Palmer hits the woodwork from distance for Chelsea in the 12th minute. Still 0–0.
say: Off the post! Palmer so close for Chelsea!
Off the post, Palmer!
Off the post!

beats.headline: GOAL! Bukayo Saka scores for Arsenal
beats.line: First goal of the match in the 41st minute. Arsenal 1–0 Chelsea.
say: Saka scores for Arsenal, 41 minutes! It's one nil to Arsenal.
Saka scores for Arsenal! It's one nil to Arsenal.
Goal, Saka! It's one nil to Arsenal.
Goal! It's one nil to Arsenal.

beats.headline: Half-time: Arsenal 1–0 Chelsea
beats.line: Arsenal 1–0 Chelsea at the break. Shots 7 to 4.
say: Half-time, and it's one nil to Arsenal.
Half-time: it's one nil to Arsenal.
Half-time.

beats.headline: GOAL! Cole Palmer equalises for Chelsea
beats.line: All square in the 55th minute. Arsenal 1–1 Chelsea.
say: Palmer levels it for Chelsea, 55 minutes! One all.
Palmer levels it for Chelsea! One all.
Goal, Palmer! One all.
Goal! One all.

beats.headline: RED CARD! Moisés Caicedo is sent off
beats.line: Chelsea are down to ten in the 63rd minute. Still 1–1.
say: Red card! Caicedo is sent off for Chelsea, 63 minutes. Down to ten!
Red card! Caicedo is off for Chelsea!
Red card, Caicedo!
Red card!

beats.headline: SAVED! Kai Havertz is denied
beats.line: Kai Havertz shoots from six yards for Arsenal in the 79th minute, but the keeper saves. Still 1–1.
say: Great save! Havertz denied for Arsenal.
Saved! Havertz denied.
Great save!

beats.headline: VAR: no goal for Chelsea
beats.line: Nicolas Jackson thought he had scored in the 84th minute. The screen says no. Still 1–1.
say: But VAR says no! Chelsea's goal is ruled out.
VAR says no goal!
No goal!

beats.headline: LATE GOAL! Gabriel Martinelli for Arsenal
beats.line: Drama in the 88th minute! Arsenal 2–1 Chelsea.
say: Late drama! Martinelli for Arsenal, 88 minutes! It's two one to Arsenal.
Late drama! Martinelli for Arsenal! It's two one to Arsenal.
Goal, Martinelli! It's two one to Arsenal.
Goal! It's two one to Arsenal.

final.headline: Full time: Arsenal win
say: And there's the final whistle! Arsenal two, Chelsea one. Arsenal take the points!
Full time! Arsenal win it, two one!
Full time! Arsenal win, two one!
Full time!
